editorial:
Imagine planning the perfect romantic gesture only for everything to go completely wrong. You get to follow a couple who seem perfect on paper, but a surprise sabotage turns a sweet marriage proposal into a total disaster. The vibe is a mix of sweet romance and stressful chaos, making you feel for the characters as they try to figure out who tried to ruin their big moment. It feels like a cozy movie you would watch on a rainy Sunday when you just want something light but engaging.

The acting is surprisingly natural, and the way the story unfolds keeps you guessing about the culprit. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the payoff is definitely worth it. If you love stories about love and betrayal, you should check this out.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the proposal was sabotaged by a jealous ex who wanted to break the couple apart. After a big confrontation and some honest conversations, the main characters realize their love is stronger than the lies. He finally proposes again, but this time it is simple and private. They both say yes, and the movie ends with them starting their new life together happily.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a bit of a mystery twist.
